tests: No new pure test is required. The embedded adapter already matches the pinned compiler-root contract, and the embedded helper has no GetExitCodeProcess call whose zero BOOL result returns a false value or raises outside the existing refusal path.
rationale: The adapter install closes over private_module._monotonic and private_module._sleep and assigns only _wait_run. The module body performs zero native, filesystem, or process actions at import or install.

wait_run admits only policy kill_on_close, one worker, and one owned record with assigned True, resumed True, and a non-None ph. Any other shape returns UNKNOWN with compiler_policy_mismatch or compiler_root_ownership.

guards() runs before WaitForSingleObject, after the wait result is stored, and after an integer GetExitCodeProcess result is stored. Cancel returns CANCELLED/cancelled, overflow returns FAILED/LOG_LIMIT, bad_read returns UNKNOWN/bad_read, and monotonic() >= dead_by returns TIMEOUT/deadline.

Wait status 258 sleeps 0.02 through the private supervisor sleep and retries. A non-int wait, any other status, or a wait exception returns UNKNOWN/wait_failed. A non-int exit or exit exception returns UNKNOWN/exit_query_failed. A nonzero exit, including 259, returns FAILED/nonzero_exit. Exit integer 0 returns COMPILER_ROOT_EXITED_CLEANUP_REQUIRED/compiler_root_exited_zero. The hook calls only WaitForSingleObject and GetExitCodeProcess on the supplied owned handle.

Embedded proof C309D2B5 on supervisor FA907 and driver E4327908 records job_close, owned_close, reader, and shutdown. Each keeps status COMPILER_ROOT_EXITED_CLEANUP_REQUIRED, sets drain_proof UNKNOWN_DRAIN, and makes validate_result raise cleanup/durability refusal, with native_process_calls empty. The embedded driver and attempt5 controller both require drain_proof CLEANUP, job_active_count 0, and whole_tree_certificate false before stage acceptance. That caller gate is the cleanup refusal for this status. Supervisor demotion edits stay outside the adapter.

Earlier Muse items about a post-exit hole, a deps/time clock fallback, renamed wait/exit reasons, worker-id mismatch tests, and STILL_ACTIVE-as-UNKNOWN describe a previous candidate. This source rechecks every terminal guard after the exit query, binds the private supervisor clock, uses wait_failed and exit_query_failed, and follows the spec rule that nonzero exit is FAILED.

Helper SHA 33F66211 contains no GetExitCodeProcess call. Completion uses proc.poll() is None, proc.wait, and proc.returncode, so child exit integer 0 stays a completed process. K32EnumProcessModules BOOL zero and K32GetModuleFileNameExW DWORD zero already raise ctypes.WinError. Those failures reach the helper's recorded-error path and INTEGRITY_REFUSED_OR_UNKNOWN when an error is stored. There is no zero-result false return to replace.
safety_checks: Adapter success is exactly COMPILER_ROOT_EXITED_CLEANUP_REQUIRED with reason compiler_root_exited_zero. whole_tree_certificate stays with the supervisor and caller, which require it false.
The wait hook's process calls are WaitForSingleObject and GetExitCodeProcess on the already-owned root handle. Job termination remains on the existing supervisor shutdown path.
The embedded four-case mock records caller_refused true and an empty native call list for job close, owned close, reader failure, and shutdown failure.

Helper module-query BOOL/DWORD zero results raise ctypes.WinError. Receipt status becomes INTEGRITY_REFUSED_OR_UNKNOWN when errors are recorded. A zero child exit remains distinct because poll is compared with None.
This audit is source-only. It applies zero patches, runs zero tests, admits zero native fixtures, and authorizes zero GPU execution.
